items: Dependency Injection: Receiving collaborators from outside instead of constructing them internally.
Git, CI & Build: Version control plus automated checks that run on every change.
Magic Methods: __construct, __get, __toString and friends that the engine invokes for you.
PHPUnit: The standard unit-testing framework for PHP.
PSR-1/12/4: PHP standards for coding style, file structure and autoloading.
SPL Structures: PHP's built-in data structures and interfaces such as ArrayObject and SplStack.
Autoloading & Composer: Loading classes on demand by PSR-4 rules; Composer wires it up.
